prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose path grid layout redesign: Redesign the choose path screen with a structured grid layout and prominent visual cards comparing pre-made pets and custom creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Choose Your Pet's Origin", "body": "Select a ready-to-adopt desktop companion or create a unique pet from your own photos."}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet traits customization screen: Insert a new pet personality traits step before adoption certificate confirmation to build deeper emotional investment.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_traits", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_traits": {"headline": "Define Your Pet's Personality", "body": "Choose traits like energetic, calm, or playful to shape how your desktop companion behaves.", "layout": "card"}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Spotlight layout pick friend screen: Redesign the pet selection screen with a spotlight hero layout featuring high-definition companion previews.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Friend", "body": "Select the companion you want living on your screen."}}
3: [home, new_flow] Estimated time rendering progress flow: Transform the waiting screen into a dynamic generation status flow with active time estimates and progress indicators.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "headline": "Bringing Your Pet to Life", "body": "Your desktop companion is being rendered. This process usually takes about 2 to 3 minutes."}}
4: [sign_in, copy] Existing account recovery sign-in headline: Update sign-in headline to emphasize logging in to restore previously saved desktop pets and account data.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Restore Your Pets", "body": "Log in with your existing account to access saved companions and sync settings across devices."}}
5: [home, layout] Centered layout pet generation status: Switch waiting screen to a centered layout featuring an animated progress bar component.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "progress", "style": "playful", "label": "Preparing desktop pet assets..."}]}}
6: [finish, hint] Desktop tray display hint: Add explicit hint text on the home intro screen detailing how to locate the pet icon in the desktop system tray.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "If your pet is not visible immediately, click the icon in your system tray or taskbar to summon it."}}
7: [choose_path, copy] Simplified path selection choice cards: Add choice card components to the path selection screen clearly separating instant adoption from photo customization.
   config: {"choose_path": {"components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "rounded", "label": "Choose between instant pet preset or photo upload"}]}}
8: [adoption, incentive] Starter pet accessories highlight: Update adoption certificate text to highlight starter pet items and toys included upon completing adoption.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"body": "Your adoption certificate is official! Your new pet comes with 3 bonus desktop toys unlocked."}}
9: [home, wait_info] Desktop preparation wait notification request: Enable notification opt-in controls on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app while generation finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Feel free to minimize this window. We'll send a desktop notification when your pet is ready."}}
